idea-plugin.name: GitButler for IDE
idea-plugin.description:
Adds GitButler virtual-branch support to the IDE: commit to virtual branches straight from the IntelliJ commit window, and browse your GitButler workspace in a dedicated tool window — unassigned changes, applied branches, their commits and the files each commit changed, with diff navigation, pull, push, unapply, rename/uncommit and drag-and-drop amend built in. The native Git branch menu gains a GitButler submenu to apply or unapply a branch.

This is an unofficial plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by GitButler. The GitButler mark is used under its CC0-1.0 brand assets (github.com/gitbutlerapp/gitbutler-brand-assets).
